author: Jayar/Vainne
short: A collection of game cogs for Red-DiscordBot.
description: GameHub is a collection of mini-games for Red-DiscordBot: Petcord (virtual pet raising), CrimeTime (crime and heists), DinoCollector (catch and trade dinos), Greenacres Fishing (fishing simulator), HighRollerClub (casino games), and Russian Roulette.
install_msg: Thanks for adding GameHub! Use `[p]cog list gamehub` to see the available games, then `[p]cog install gamehub <cog>` to install one.
